positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Develop fully functional applications using Java, SQL, Spring, Angular, and Typescript. Build CI/CD Pipelines using GitLabs, and Docker. Build testing environments with JUnit, Mockito, MockMVC, Jasmine/Karma, and Cypress.

positions.title: Big Data Engineer
positions.description:
Big Data Engineer with Scala, using Hadoop with, Hive, Spark, as well as Kafka.
Performing Data Analytics using Spark and SparkSQL in order to provide analysis to business on sales,
trends, and future outcome of company earnings.
Experience managing databases with MySQL and Scala, as well as using Python to develop applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a small team with Scrum framework to develop an application using C++ programming
language, and Dijkstra's Algorithm.
The application in question uses Dijkstra's Algorithm to develop a the shortest/most cost-efficient path
to traverse baseball stadiums from California to a stadium picked by the customer whilst visiting other
stadiums in the process.
The application features a GUI that lets customers pick a stadium within California (Angels or Dodgers)
and a destination stadium anywhere in the US, the application then uses the algorithm to calculate the
shortest path to the destination in the graph (map of the USA with baseball stadiums).
In the application, nodes represent stadiums and edges represent "miles" or "flight money" that will cost
to travel between stadium to stadium.
positions.insights: Graphs, Graphical User Interface (GUI) and +4 skills
